problem.title: Find Triplets with Sum Zero
problem.description: Given an array of integers, find all unique triplets that sum to zero. Return triplets in ascending order.

heavy_input_generator:
import random
n = 10000
arr = [random.randint(-1000000, 1000000) for _ in range(n)]
print(' '.join(map(str, arr)))
optimization_goal: Replace O(N^3) brute force with O(N^2) two-pointer approach: sort array, fix first element, use two pointers for remaining elements

problem.title: Longest Common Subsequence
problem.description: Find the length of the longest common subsequence between two strings. A subsequence is a sequence derived by deleting some or no elements without changing the order.

heavy_input_generator:
import random
import string
n = 10000
print(''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_uppercase, k=n)))
print(''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_uppercase, k=n)))
optimization_goal: Replace O(2^min(m,n)) recursion with O(m*n) dynamic programming, then optimize space to O(min(m,n))

problem.title: Count Subarrays with Target Sum
problem.description: Given an array of integers and a target sum, count the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals the target.

heavy_input_generator:
import random
n = 100000
target = random.randint(-1000000, 1000000)
arr = [random.randint(-1000000, 1000000) for _ in range(n)]
print(f'{target}')
print(' '.join(map(str, arr)))
optimization_goal: Replace O(N^2) nested loops with O(N) prefix sum + hash map approach

problem.title: Find All Duplicate Value Pairs
problem.description: Given an array of integers, find all pairs of indices (i, j) where i < j and arr[i] == arr[j]. Return sorted list of index pairs.

heavy_input_generator:
import random
n = 10000
arr = [random.randint(-1000000, 1000000) for _ in range(n)]
print(' '.join(map(str, arr)))
optimization_goal: Replace O(N^2) nested loops with O(N) hash map to group indices by value

problem.title: Matrix Maximum Path Sum
problem.description: Given an m x n matrix, find the maximum sum path from top-left to bottom-right. You can only move right or down.

heavy_input_generator:
import random
m = 1000
n = 1000
for i in range(m):
    row = [random.randint(-1000000, 1000000) for _ in range(n)]
    print(row)
optimization_goal: Replace O(2^(m+n)) recursion with O(m*n) dynamic programming, then optimize space to O(n)
